_readme: Who Exiled is. Two lists, because they are different identities.
names        League accounts, including the RU server. The active player
normally resolves from the Live Client API, which is
reliable; this list is the fallback for EVENT names, whose
format differs and which have already been seen non-Latin
('Your creatures on team болтяра died'). When _is_me fails
there his own kills and deaths route as ALLY events, and she
talks about him in the third person while reacting to
everything.
chat_names   Twitch logins that are HIM. This is what selects the
CHAT_EXILED framing, gives his message OWNER_PRIORITY, and
stops it being dropped when a viewer's message scores
higher in the same batch.
KEEP chat_names EXACT. A Twitch login is a claim anyone can register:
'exiled' and 'exiledr' are not his, they are handles somebody else could
take, and listing them would hand that person owner privileges — her
loyal framing, priority over every game event, and a bypass of the voice
gate. Only add a name he actually owns and logs in as. Matching is
case-insensitive, so 'Exiledra1n' and 'EXILEDRA1N' are covered without
listing them.
The `names` list is looser on purpose and safely so: it is matched against
League event text on his own machine, where nobody else can choose what it
says.
(Mods are deliberately not modelled. If they ever get their own standing
it should be a third list with its own framing, not an entry here —
'trusted' and 'is the streamer' are different things.)
